from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extraction result for a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(..., description="The specific title of the document (e.g., 《判决文书 1》)")
    assigned_cause: str = Field(..., description="The cause of action from the task list assigned to this document")
    supporting_evidence: str = Field(..., description="Brief text or reasoning justifying the cause assignment")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Root model aggregating extracted records."""
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
